title: Vault milestones
description: Which frontmatter properties mark a milestone (birthday, holiday, …) and how it is worded. Shared by the senaev-personal-tools plugin and any external code that collects milestones for a date.

version.description: Format version. Incremented on any change that an existing consumer cannot read.

hiddenProperty.description: A note whose frontmatter sets this property to the YAML boolean `true` shows none of its milestones. Any other value is ignored.

minKnownYear.description: Dates with an earlier year recur without a known start (e.g. `0001-12-31`), so no age is computed for them.

tomorrowEmoji.description: Fills `{{EMOJI}}` for a milestone that falls on the day after the requested date.

property.description: Frontmatter property holding a `YYYY-MM-DD` date. Day and month are matched; the year is used only for `{{AGE}}`.

ruleProperty.description: Optional frontmatter property holding an RFC 5545 RRULE value (e.g. `FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=11;BYDAY=-1SU`) for dates that must be calculated. The rule is evaluated as if DTSTART were 1 January of the requested year at 00:00 UTC. `FREQ` is required; `DTSTART` and `COUNT` are not supported. Such milestones have no `{{AGE}}`. See rule-test-vectors.json.

emoji.description: Fills `{{EMOJI}}` when the milestone falls on the requested date.

template.description: Display text. Placeholders: `{{FILENAME}}` (note name without extension), `{{AGE}}` (`(N)` or empty), `{{EMOJI}}`. Whitespace runs are collapsed and the result is trimmed.
